**Answer: October 9, 1952 is the date most sources give, but the evidence doesn't settle the exact day.** All the sources agree on October 1952. Wikipedia gives both October 9 and October 10, and I found no primary source that fixes the day. I did the research directly with searches and page reads rather than spawning the skill's subagents. Its workflow needs shell commands and local files, which you ruled out.

**Claims and sources**

- The UN says construction of the headquarters complex was completed in 1952. That is the year only, with no day.
  - https://www.un.org/ungifts/secretariat-building
- Another history site says construction was "officially completed in October 1952". It gives no day.
  - https://classicnewyorkhistory.com/history-of-the-united-nations-headquarters-in-new-york/
- The Wikipedia infobox for the UN Headquarters gives a completion date of October 9, 1952.
  - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations_Headquarters
- The body text of the same article says the Manhattan headquarters "was declared complete on October 10, 1952". It contradicts its own infobox.
  - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations_Headquarters
- Untapped New York says the Manhattan headquarters was not completed until October 9, 1952. A search summary of that page said so; I did not open it.
  - https://www.untappedcities.com/united-nations-lake-success/
- Wikipedia's General Assembly Building article gives October 10, 1952 as that one building's formal dedication. That is a different event from completing the whole complex.
  - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations_General_Assembly_Building
- Earlier milestones, so "completed" isn't confused with them:
  - The Secretariat building was finished in 1950–51. Wikipedia says staff began moving in on August 22, 1950, and it was completed in June 1951. I did not open that article, so the June 1951 date comes from a search summary.
    - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations_Secretariat_Building
  - The Dag Hammarskjöld Library was dedicated in November 1961, after the main complex was finished.
    - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Nations_Headquarters

I used five retrievals: two searches, two page reads, and one more search.
